import json

data = json.loads(files)
entries = data.get("entries", [])

# Group by top-level directory
from collections import defaultdict
groups = defaultdict(list)
for e in entries:
    path = e["path"].replace("/workspace/", "")
    parts = path.split("/")
    top = parts[0] if len(parts) > 1 else "(root)"
    groups[top].append({"name": e["name"], "path": path, "is_dir": e["is_dir"], "size": e.get("size_bytes", 0)})

summary_lines = []
summary_lines.append(f"Total files/entries: {len(entries)}\n")
summary_lines.append("## Workspace Structure\n")

for top_dir in sorted(groups.keys()):
    items = groups[top_dir]
    total_size = sum(i["size"] for i in items)
    summary_lines.append(f"### 📁 {top_dir}/ ({len(items)} files, {total_size:,} bytes)")
    for item in sorted(items, key=lambda x: x["path"]):
        icon = "📁" if item["is_dir"] else "📄"
        summary_lines.append(f"  {icon} {item['path']} ({item['size']:,} bytes)")
    summary_lines.append("")

workspace_summary = "\n".join(summary_lines)
print(workspace_summary)
